alerts.reason: Black Knight reported lower mortgage origination volumes as rates rose after a prolonged period of elevated refinancing (C). I forecast Q3 consolidated revenue growth above -5% and a Q4 decline of at least 5% as fewer originations generate transaction revenue. The timing is uncertain because the filing does not quantify revenue tied to originations.

nLIGHT’s first-half revenue fell 4.0% year over year, from $130.5 million to $125.3 million. Product sales outside China rose and partly offset declines in China sales and development revenue (A). I expect that offset to keep Q3 above -5%, with weaker demand and delayed customer capital spending pushing the Q4 decline to at least 5% (B).

Matson’s Q2 Ocean Transportation revenue grew 53.6%, supporting a forecast for consolidated revenue growth above -5% in Q3 (A). Hawaii container volume had already fallen 1.5% year over year, and Matson cited lower retail-related demand (B, C). I forecast a Q4 consolidated decline of at least 5% if that weakness spreads beyond Hawaii.
